messages:
ashley: Quick heads-up — planning a config-only deploy in the dawn change window at 06:00 UTC. No model changes, just routing/batching/limits. Pinning v2-lite@rev3b for latency-sensitive tenants.

ashley: TL;DR of changes: per-tenant qps cap 12 -> 10, batch window 20ms -> 10ms, idle_kvcache_ttl 300s -> 180s, routing policy: prefer-dedicated for tier=enterprise.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy 'config:dawn-slowlift' to eng-dedicated at 06:00 UTC. Canary: 5% traffic, 15m gating. Operator: @kevin. Link: https://internal.redwood/release/6211112222

miguel: Ack. What metrics should we watch during canary? p50/p95/p99, error-rate, and host OOMs?

kevin: yea — watch p95 token-latency, queue_length, cpu/gpu-accept-rate. Canary gating rules: abort if p95 increases >20% over baseline OR error-rate >0.5% sustained for 3m OR OOM seen on any node.

sre-jen: Add tracing tag redwood.deploy=6211112222 and capture sample traces for 1% of requests. Also enable extra logging for tenant=highq for 15m.

ashley: config snippet I'm pushing as the canary payload: 
```
routing_policy: prefer-dedicated
batching:
  max_wait_ms: 10
  max_batch_tokens: 1024
limits:
  tenant_qps_cap: 10
kvcache:
  idle_ttl_s: 180
pin_model: v2-lite@rev3b
```

miguel: Quick check — pin avoids model auto-rotate, right? We don't want a quantized swap mid-canary.

ashley: Correct. Pinning prevents auto-rollover to newer model variants. Important for stable perf comparison.

kevin: Ops plan: I'll run canary on a small dedicated pool. At +15m, if healthy, we ramp to 25% for 30m, then to 60% for 20m, then full. Manual hold at each step.

miguel: If we see borderline p95 (10-20% increase) but no errors, roll-forward only after product ok? We should notify product and SRE.

ashley: Agreed — escalation: if borderline, tag product and @sre oncall. Rollback criteria still take precedence.

kevin: Rollback playbook: revert routing_policy, restore tenant_qps_cap to 12, revert batch window to 20ms, unpin only after full stability. If we rollback, alert customers via status page if >5% of traffic impacted.

deploy-bot: Canary started at 06:00:00 UTC — canary id cb-6211112222-1. Monitoring hooks attached.

miguel: Monitoring dashboards to watch: infra/latency/token-latency, routing/queue-length, tenant/highq/error-rate. Setting alerts: p95_up_20pc and errors_gt_0_5pc.

ashley: Release notes (summary for internal changelog): "Config-only deploy: tighter per-tenant QPS, reduced batching wait to lower latency, shorter kvcache TTL, routing preference for enterprise tenants, model pin for v2-lite@rev3b. Canary gating + rollback criteria included." Link to full notes: https://internal.redwood/changelog/6211112222

kevin: thumbs up. I'll be on standby from 05:45-07:30 UTC. ping me in this thread during roll. :thumbsup:

sre-jen: I'll keep an eye on infra alerts. If any node reports OOM we abort immediately and follow rollback steps.

ashley: thanks all. After canary completes I'll post a short postmortem/observations (perf deltas and any anomalies).

kevin: noted. Good luck. :rocket:
